floater.title: Choose gestures or sounds
floater.string: Click to play a gesture or sound; click a playing gesture to stop. Right-click to customize.
Gesture boards are available after login.
Saved board data could not be read. It was kept unchanged.
Wait for Inventory to finish loading.
The gesture, sound or its Inventory link is unavailable. Replace it through the tile menu.
Playback is unavailable. Gestures may be disabled or restricted.
Loading the selected gesture… Clicks will not queue more plays.
Gesture started through the normal viewer engine.
Sound sent for in-world playback. One-shot sounds cannot be stopped after sending.
Pending board plays cancelled; board-started gestures stopped. Already emitted sound/chat cannot be recalled.
Pending board playback cancelled.
The gesture could not be loaded. Try again or replace its tile.
The gesture did not load within 30 seconds. No delayed play is queued.
The board, item or login changed. Reopen the editor/picker and try again.
Maximum: 16 boards and 64 tiles per board. Your saved setup was kept.
That board name is already used. Choose another name.
Use 1–64 characters for board names and up to 64 for tile text; avoid control characters.
Board configuration saved. Inventory items were unchanged.
That item already has a tile on this board.
Unavailable item
Select gestures or sounds with Ctrl/Shift, then Add. Sounds play in-world when clicked on the board.
Select one gesture or sound when replacing a tile.
